name: jarvis-ai
description: - Responsive futuristic JARVIS HUD interface. - Local date, clock, online/offline status and battery level where supported. - Browser speech recognition where supported (Chrome on Android is recommended). - Speech synthesis / spoken test response. - Local language and backend URL settings. - Chat UI that clearly reports when AI is not configured. - Optional backend connection contract: `POST {BACKEND_URL}/chat` with JSON `{ "message": "...", "language": "en-IN" }`; expected JSON response `{ "reply": "..." }`.
